summary: RTL audit (iteration 41) on dashboard + admin surfaces verified against preview URL. The bulk ml->ms / mr->me / pl->ps / pr->pe Perl transform across 23 files in components/dashboard + components/admin, plus the 5 targeted left-/right- -> start-/end- swaps (BulkManagerTab search icon, SmartPricingModal price-suffix, ManagerHeader notif badge, LikedTab close-button + bottom badge) all confirmed in source via grep. Behaviour validated live: (1) BulkManager's start-3 magnifier icon renders on physical RIGHT in Hebrew RTL (bb_left=1287, parent_right=1315, side=PHYS-RIGHT) - correct. (2) SmartPricingModal's three end-3 currency suffixes (Max/Base/Min nightly) all render on physical LEFT in RTL (side=PHYS-LEFT) - correct, screenshot shows the ILS symbol on the left of each input. (3) Dashboard renders cleanly RTL with Hebrew tab strip flowing right-to-left. (4) Admin dashboard loads cleanly in both LTR and RTL with no overflow / overlap. (5) Zero console errors across all flows. The -end-2 badge in ManagerHeader.jsx and end-3/start-3 on LikedTab cards were not observable at runtime because the visible notification bell on /dashboard is rendered by Navigation.jsx (not ManagerHeader.jsx) and the owner account has zero liked properties - both patches are confirmed in source and will flip correctly via Tailwind logical utilities when those surfaces render.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind logical utilities (start-/end-/ms-/me-/ps-/pe-) verified to correctly resolve based on html[dir] attribute — start-3 -> right edge in RTL, end-3 -> left edge in RTL, confirmed via getComputedStyle and bounding box checks.

Switching locale via localStorage.setItem('i18nextLng', 'en') + reload does NOT reliably reset i18next back to English on the dashboard route (dir stays rtl after reload). The user-facing language toggle button works, but programmatic localStorage manipulation alone is insufficient. This is i18next detector behaviour and NOT a bug introduced by this RTL polish — but worth knowing for future tests.

ManagerHeader.jsx (-end-2 badge) and LikedTab.jsx (end-3 close / start-3 default badge) source-level patches were verified via grep but the runtime surfaces weren't reachable in this test session (notification bell rendered by Navigation.jsx, owner has 0 liked items). Recommend adding a smoke screenshot or seeding a liked property if future iterations want runtime confirmation.
